blocks.html:
The Simpsons Guitar Wrap

Who doesn’t love a nice-looking guitar? Whether it is just sitting in your room as just a decor piece or if you actually make sweet music with it. The one thing everyone can relate to is that when you get a guitar it’s the same design as everyone else’s, and that is enough to make you feel like it’s nothing special.

We at Vinyl Wrap Toronto recognize that feeling when you feel like what you got needs a personal touch. Our vinyl wrap installers have years of professional experience and are capable of wrapping almost anything, as long as it has a smooth surface. Besides doing an amazing job wrapping vehicles (cars, trucks, vans, boats, etc.) our team enjoys wrapping various equipment.

Guitars are interesting instruments, not only do they produce great music, but they can also add a nice touch to your home decor. It gets boring when you realize the guitar you have is lacking a personal touch that makes it obvious that the guitar belongs to you. Vinyl Wrap Toronto installers are here to help you customize your guitar to look exactly as you want it to look.

From doing a full wrap to putting stickers, decals, and personal quotes on your guitar, there’s nothing our team can not wrap. Over the years we have turned some boring-looking guitars into one-of-a-kind masterpieces. With a custom-designed graphic, you could make your guitar stand out from all those boring ones.

This lady came to us with very specific instructions on what she wanted. She said she is a fan of the popular animated TV show The Simpsons. So, she wanted to get her old guitar wrapped with a graphic from that particular show. The Simpsons is a wildly popular American animated sitcom that puts a comical twist on the daily life events of a working-class family. The lady decided to get it done after she saw someone else’s guitar wrapped in a personalized vinyl wrap sheet.

Her idea was to get her electric guitar wrapped with a vinyl sheet that features the Simpsons on the front and her favourite character i.e Blinky on the back and sides of the guitar. We obviously took on the job and she was fully satisfied with the results. We have featured some of the images for you to see how you can get something personal to you on your instruments or gadgets.

We have a team of professional graphic designers. When a customer comes we ask them for their requirements and how they picture their design to look. After carefully analyzing the requirements, our designers start rendering those ideas into a digital design. Then, it is sent to the customer for approval. The customer can either request a modification or approve the design.

When the customer approves it, we start the printing process. We use various types of vinyl wrap brands and our installers are always here to guide you on which one would be the best fit for your needs but ultimately it’s your decision. We use Avery Dennison & 3M for the most part.

So if you’ve got something that’s in desperate need of a makeover, we got your back at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. Our motto is if it has a smooth surface, we can wrap it. Our team likes to show off their skills by wrapping objects that aren’t typically wrapped. Some of those things include the following equipment:

  1. Heels: yes, you read it right. We were not kidding when we said we can wrap anything. If you’re looking to add a little customized vinyl goodness to your shoes/heels, we are here to make that a reality.
  2. TV Boxes: One of our clients wanted to give out TVs and they needed their branding on those boxes, and since Vinyl Wrap Toronto is such a flexible and versatile agency, they relied on us to get the job done. And it goes without saying that we did it with absolute perfection and professionalism.
  3. Laptops: We were not kidding when we said we can wrap anything that has a smooth surface. A laptop is a gadget that you end up using often in your daily life. It’s sad to see that almost all the laptops come with a similar and dull look. Vinyl Wrap Toronto offers laptop wrapping services. Tell us what you wish and we will make sure to wrap your laptop with your favourite graphic. It is a really great way to freshen up the appearance of your gadgets.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto is one of the leading vehicle wrap agencies in the GTA. Having years of experience, we have mastered the art of wrapping vehicles as well as equipment. If you’ve got something that you could use as a vinyl wrap, call us today at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON M9W 1B4 to see us in action.
